about: The canvas v2 phase 5 authority matrix (14.1): op x actor x target x settings -> live, propose (with the first proposing rule's reason) or refuse (with the code). The ``peer_hosted`` target is a peer's mark inside a container the actor made (A1): geometry lives, words propose. Undo rows (not proposable, but freezes, locks and authority bind them) add "skipped": "frozen" when the undo applies and leaves frozen marks as they are; an undo that would take nothing back (all of it frozen) is refused op_invalid, saying why. tests/test_canvas_collab_matrix.py runs every row; a new rule adds rows here.
